sql.link.getLinksForCompany: select * from flow.link where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true
sql.link.getAvailableLinksForProcessStep: select l.* from flow.link l where l.archived is not true and l.company_id = :companyId and not exists ( select process_step_id from flow.process_step_link psl where psl.link_id = l.id and psl.process_step_id = :id and archived is not true ) order by l.link
sql.link.getProcessStepLink: SELECT psl.id, psl.link_id as "linkId", psl.created_by_id as "createdById", psl.process_step_id as "processStepId", psl.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", l.link, l.url, psl.archived FROM flow.process_step_link psl inner join flow.link l on l.id = psl.link_id where psl.id = :id
sql.link.insertProcessStepLink: insert into flow.process_step_link (link_id, process_step_id, created_by_id, date_created) values (:linkId, :processStepId, :createdById, now())
sql.link.getLink: select id, link, company_id, archived, url from flow.link where company_id = :companyId and id = :linkId
sql.link.deleteProcessStepLink: update flow.process_step_link set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.link.deleteLink: update flow.link set archived = true where id = :id
sql.link.updateLink: update flow.link set link = :link, url = :url where id = :id
sql.link.getAvailableLinksForAction: select l.* from flow.link l where l.archived is not true and l.company_id = :companyId and not exists ( select psl.process_step_action_id from flow.process_step_action_link psl where psl.link_id = l.id and psl.process_step_action_id = :id and archived is not true ) order by l.link
